title: Replace Air Filter
description: Mock procedure for replacing a rectangular HVAC air filter.

steps.title: Locate filter housing
steps.instruction: Find the return air grille or filter slot on the HVAC unit.
safetyNotes: Do not remove panels from energized equipment.
steps.expectedOutcome: The user is positioned at the filter access point.

steps.title: Power down unit
steps.instruction: Switch the thermostat or unit control to off before opening the housing.
safetyNotes: Keep hands clear of moving fan components.

steps.title: Remove old filter
steps.instruction: Open the grille or access cover and slide out the old filter, noting the airflow arrow direction.
safetyNotes: Wear gloves if the filter is dusty.
steps.expectedOutcome: The old filter is removed and airflow direction is known.

steps.title: Install new filter
steps.instruction: Insert the new filter with the airflow arrow pointing toward the blower or ductwork.
steps.confirmationPrompt: New filter installed in the correct direction?
steps.expectedOutcome: The new filter is seated correctly.

steps.title: Close housing and restart
steps.instruction: Close the grille or cover, then restore the thermostat or unit control to normal operation.
safetyNotes: Confirm the cover is secured before restarting.
steps.expectedOutcome: The HVAC system is operating with the new filter installed.
